description: Each river is divided into a number of individual river water bodies for monitoring purposes and this helps us manage and protect our rivers at a local scale.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry in WGS 84 (OGC:CRS84) after conversion; the service stores it in TM65 / Irish Grid (EPSG:29902). The only column declared as geometry.

table:columns.name: EU_CD
table:columns.description: European water body code, the identifier the water body is reported under to the European Commission for the Water Framework Directive.

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the water body.

table:columns.name: URL
table:columns.description: Link to the EPA catchments.ie page for the water body.

table:columns.name: URLtext
table:columns.description: Display label for the URL column.

table:columns.name: MS_CD
table:columns.description: Member State code of the water body.

table:columns.name: INS_WHEN
table:columns.description: Internal EPA database field recording when the row was inserted.

table:columns.name: LAT
table:columns.description: Latitude of a representative point of the water body.

table:columns.name: LON
table:columns.description: Longitude of a representative point of the water body.

table:columns.name: LENGTHKM
table:columns.description: Length of the river water body in kilometres as computed by the EPA.

table:columns.name: DateChanged
table:columns.description: Date the EPA last changed this water body record.

table:columns.name: Change
table:columns.description: Nature of the last change the EPA made to this water body record.

table:columns.name: GEOLOGY
table:columns.description: Geology class of the water body used in the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: CatchmentAreaKm2
table:columns.description: Area of the catchment draining to the water body, in square kilometres, as computed by the EPA.

table:columns.name: CatchmentAreaHectares
table:columns.description: Area of the catchment draining to the water body, in hectares, as computed by the EPA.

table:columns.name: Slope
table:columns.description: Mean slope of the river water body reach as computed by the EPA and used in the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: Altitude
table:columns.description: Altitude of the water body used in the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: WaterManagementUnit
table:columns.description: Water management unit the water body is assigned to under the River Basin Management Plan.

table:columns.name: Easting
table:columns.description: Easting of a representative point in the Irish Grid (EPSG:29902), in metres.

table:columns.name: Northing
table:columns.description: Northing of a representative point in the Irish Grid (EPSG:29902), in metres.

table:columns.name: LocalAuthority
table:columns.description: Local authority or authorities the water body lies in.

table:columns.name: ARTIFICIAL
table:columns.description: Marks whether the water body is an artificial water body within the meaning of the Water Framework Directive.

table:columns.name: CATEGORY
table:columns.description: Water body category code of the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: TYPE
table:columns.description: Water body type code of the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: ALT_CAT
table:columns.description: Altitude category code of the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: SIZE_CAT
table:columns.description: Size category code of the Water Framework Directive typology.

table:columns.name: HydrometricArea
table:columns.description: Hydrometric area the water body lies in.

table:columns.name: Canal
table:columns.description: Marks whether the water body is a canal.

table:columns.name: Transboundary
table:columns.description: Marks whether the water body crosses the border with Northern Ireland and is therefore reported jointly.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, added by the GeoParquet conversion.
